description: The best price for a token swap on one network, or a transfer to another network (bridge), and what the sender signs to make it. Works on every network in get_networks. Returns toAmount, toAmountMin (the least the recipient gets), the fees, and one of: transactionRequest (EVM: approve approvalAddress for exactly fromAmount first unless fromToken is the coin), transaction (Solana), messages (TON), tron (Tron), cosmos (a Cosmos network) or deposit (an address to pay; nothing to sign). Call get_signing_guide with the quote's fromChainId for the exact steps. Works without an API key at a low shared rate; a free key gives your own limits and fee.

fromAddress.description: The wallet that pays and signs (or, for a deposit, the sender's own address there for refunds)

fromAmount.description: Amount sold, an integer string in the token's smallest unit (or give toAmount)

fromChainId.description: Where the trade starts: a chainId from get_networks, e.g. 8453 for Base

fromToken.description: Token sold, as that network writes it; on EVM networks the coin is 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, elsewhere the network's nativeToken

integratorBps.description: Your own fee in basis points, up to your key's limit (needs your own key)

slippageBps.description: Max price move in basis points, 1 to 5000 (default 50). A cross-chain route whose own swaps need more room may use up to 300; toAmountMin shows the least that arrives

toAddress.description: Where the tokens go; defaults to fromAddress, required when the recipient is on another kind of network

toAmount.description: Instead of fromAmount, for a swap on one EVM network: an exact amount to receive. The quote's fromAmount is then what it takes to send, and toAmountMin is never below this amount

toChainId.description: Where the recipient receives: fromChainId for a swap (the default), or another network from get_networks to bridge there

toToken.description: Token bought, as the destination network writes it

name: get_quote
title: Get a quote
